title: Project Manager and Designer
description: Project Manager asks Designer to turn the reference image into a Minecraft blueprint. Designer reports assumptions, tool calls, artifacts, and uncertain visual regions.

messages.text: Hi Designer, here is the image path: workspace/Craft_Utopia/tiantan.png. Please convert it into a Minecraft blueprint.

messages.systemLog: Send message: Project Manager sends the image path and blueprint request to Designer.

messages.text: I received the image path. The input is an image file, so before we can make a usable Minecraft blueprint, I first need to reconstruct it as a 3D model. I will call TRELLIS to convert the image into mesh.obj and camera.json.

messages.systemLog: Receive message: Designer receives an image file and decides to convert it into a 3D model first.

messages.text: I am calling TRELLIS from the run folder now. This tool will reconstruct a 3D mesh from the single reference image using seed 2147.

messages.systemLog: Tools Call: TRELLIS converts workspace/Craft_Utopia/tiantan.png into a 3D mesh and camera metadata.

messages.text: I have the 3D model now. Next I can convert the model into a Minecraft schematic blueprint, so I will call obj2schematic to voxelize the mesh with the project palette.

messages.systemLog: Tools Call: obj2schematic converts mesh.obj into stage_preview.schem with the project palette and block tolerance.

messages.text: The schematic is ready. I still need a planner-friendly blueprint file, so I will call schematic_export to produce sorted block placements, layer numbers, and region bounds.

messages.systemLog: Tools Call: schematic_export converts stage_preview.schem into placements.jsonl for Project Manager planning.

messages.text: Blueprint ready. I am returning placements.jsonl, stage_preview.schem, mesh_review.json, cues.json, and 23 low-confidence placements in uncertain_edges.json.

messages.systemLog: Send message: Designer returns the completed blueprint files, mesh review, visual cues, and uncertain placement list to Project Manager.
